messages.text: Mort's just really stubborn when it comes to The Catacombs. He's seen so many adventurers get lost down there that he now refuses to let anyone in without a buddy.
messages.zh: 一提到地牢，Mort 就特别固执。他见过太多冒险者在里面迷路，所以现在没有同伴，他就不放人进去。
